# User Preferences

Users can configure personalized settings that are used throughout the application. For example: If you set a default system, then when you access a screen that requires a system selection, the System field will already be populated with the default system you specified.

Settings are specific to each user.

<div class="procedure">

To access the User Preferences screen:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **User Preferences** in the **User Settings** group.

</div>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the User Preferences screen:

- **Message Path** - The location of import messages created during the manual import process. Click the **Browse** button to select a folder where the file will be saved (example: D:\Flow-Cal\Logfiles). Each time a location or list is imported, a file is created with the list or location name and a .txt file extension.

If you do not define a message path, the import messages will not be stored in a permanent file.

- **Graph Centric** - If enabled, the Volume Editor will automatically display the data in graphical form instead of in a tabular grid.

  You can also switch between tabular and graphical mode from the Volume Editor **File** menu.

- **Batch Import Mismatch Pause** - If enabled, a manual list or location import will pause if a meter number in the CFX import file does not match the FLOWCAL meter number it is being imported into. During this pause, you can review the discrepancy and elect to cancel or continue the import. (This feature only applies to manual import of CFX files.)

- **Volume Editor Auto Open** - If enabled, FLOWCAL will remember the value of the Auto option in the Volume Editor for the duration of your FLOWCAL session. This option is enabled by default.

- **Remember UI Filter Values** - If enabled, FLOWCAL will remember your filter settings in the Exception Resolver, Meter/Location Rollups Viewer, Volume Editor, and Standard Reports for the duration of your FLOWCAL session.

- **Hide Virtual Batches** - If enabled, virtual batches will be hidden.

- **Virtual Batch Hide Duration** - If the Hide Virtual Batches option is enabled, you can specify a minimum batch length to hide. This allows users to hide short gaps, but show longer gaps where data may be missing.

  The time period is denoted in hours, minutes and seconds, defaulted to 0 hours, 0 minutes, and 0 seconds.

  - If you leave the default value at 0 hours, 0 minutes, and 0 seconds, all virtual batches are hidden.
  - If you change the value to 0 hours, 0 minutes, and 5 seconds, only virtual batches less than or equal to five seconds in length are hidden, but virtual batches greater than five seconds in length are shown.

- **Default System** - Selecting a default system automatically populates the System drop-down field on any FLOWCAL screen that requires a system to be specified.

- **Notes Visibility** - This designation sets the default visibility for notes that a user creates. Options are:
  - **Everyone** - Anyone in the FLOWCAL application can see the note and it can be printed on reports such as Batch Ticket.
  - **Internal** - Anyone in the FLOWCAL application can see the note and it can be printed on reports such as Batch Ticket when the option to print internal notes is enabled.
  - **Private** - Only the person who entered the note can see it in FLOWCAL. It will not be printed on any reports.

- **Preferred Location** - Selecting a preferred location makes the selected location the default location when entering the Location Tree Editor.

- **Default Personality** (TESTit 2 Integrated only) - Defines the default application personality to be used upon initial login.

- **Default Fluid Phase** - Defines the default fluid phase (gas or liquid) to be used upon creation of a new meter, location, or source analysis.
